title: ArcEconomy
description: Player-managed currencies and local economies, in one plugin
body:
# 💰 ArcEconomy — Multi-Currency Economy Plugin
ArcEconomy is a powerful and flexible economy plugin for Minecraft that allows you to create and manage multiple custom currencies, enabling complex, player-driven economies on your server.
## Create Your Own Currencies
Move beyond traditional single-currency systems.
With ArcEconomy, you can create fully customizable currencies and use them for trading, payments, and economic interactions between players.
## ⚙️ Full Control Over Your Currency
Each currency has its own management system, allowing you to:
- Control how much money is in circulation
- Decide who is allowed to mint currency
- Manage deposits, withdrawals, and permissions
This gives server owners and players the tools to build stable or experimental economies, depending on how currencies are managed.
## 🔄 Currency Exchange & Player Payments
- Pay other players using any available currency
- Exchange currencies with other players
- Convert one currency into another through player-to-player trades
- These systems encourage local and global economies, driven entirely by player activity.
## 📈 Dynamic Currency Value
The value and power of a currency evolve based on how it is used:
- Frequent exchanges can increase a currency’s economic influence
- Excessive minting can cause inflation
- Rapid withdrawals can reduce trust and value
Every decision matters — making economic strategy a core gameplay element.
